summary.text: Jason Heaser is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 34A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Danny Nadeau (R).
A prosecutor and U.S. Army veteran who served from 2001 to 2025, he holds a law degree from the University of Notre Dame.

paragraphs.text: Jason Heaser earned a high school diploma from Winona Senior High School, a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University and a law degree from the University of Notre Dame.
His career experience includes working as a prosecutor, and he served in the U.S. Army from 2001 to 2025.
